assertions: Preserve complete original managed and noncopyable pointer ownership, distinct deep copy versus clone, and native equality/error contracts.
Verify unchanged whole pinned native headers normal and ASan/UBSan with complete initialized allocation/copy/clone/destruction streams.
Retain exact prior related coverage plus complete affected mdds owners/tests at raw S/B/F/L100 with all original source links absent.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task63 implements complete original managed_element_block and noncopyable_managed_element_block over the existing shared element_block/delayed_delete_vector, with explicit erased native ValueT copy/delete, optional equality used only by noncopyable equal_block, and optional clone_value specialization. Pointer storage is borrowed; destructor and overwrite delete only active pointees and preserve original dangling slots until caller replacement. Managed copy constructor deep-copies only live elements, resets delayed front offset, and implicit copy assignment copies pointer storage. Noncopyable copy throws the original error; default clone throws and clone_value transforms the copied live range retaining original delayed offset. Static noncopyable equality dereferences values; copyable and instance equality compare pointers. Full unchanged verified mdds3.2.1 headers match complete13383byte normal/ASan/UBSan initialized streams; actual ValueT operations are type witnesses, not a replacement provider. Generalized borrowed-pointer generic constraints retain scalar behavior. Complete bases, clone functor and managed factory specializations share the original types.ts boundary, within the repository file budget and without a runtime module cycle. Scalar object-value copying/destruction, custom StoreT/allocator/parallel execution policy, exceptions/invalid dangling or null dereferences, physical pointer/ABI and full MTV/Calc cell objects/document/UI remain unverified; no whole-module or upstream QA certification.
